~/hub                       |HELP  ? or :help shows this; q or Esc closes it
v hub  (project)            |
  v providers/              |PANES  select one in the bar (j/k, ]] [[); Enter opens it
      claude-main           |  settings     the root row: af config show --origin
      codex-ambient         |  providers/   af provider status; d removes a registered Provider
  v workers/                |  workers/     the Worker packages HEAD commits, and their Attempts
      fixture/evaluator     |  pipelines/   af task plan and af task explain --tree, token-free
      fixture/implementer   |  tasks/       the Tasks of every Task Store: this scope's, every
  v pipelines/              |               --state DIR the Store registry records, and :state DIR
      review                |  campaigns/   every review Campaign, as af review campaigns lists it
      fixture/implementation|
  v tasks/                  |: <af command>   runs any af command line here (:task list,
  v campaigns/              |                 :review campaigns, :provider status), with the
                            |                 terminal handed to it; Enter comes back.
                            |
                            |KEYS  (docs/design/tui.md section 4)
                            |
                            |j k                row down / up
                            |h l                bar: close / open a folder, or go to parent / first
                            |                   main pane: scroll sideways
                            |gg G               first / last row
                            |<C-d> <C-u>        half page down / up
                            |<C-f> <C-b>        page down / up; <C-b> on the bar hides it, and shows
                            |zo zc za           open / close / toggle the folder under the cursor
                            |zR zM              open / close every folder
                            |/ n N              search the focused region; next / previous match
                            |?                  this help
                            |Tab <C-w>l <C-w>h  move focus between the bar and the main pane
                            |]] [[              next / previous folder
HELP  hub                                                                   j/k scroll  q close help
